title: Arabic OCR benchmark manifest (roadmap Stage 3.2)
description: One record per page: where the image is (outside git unless rights-cleared), the typed ground truth, the rights record and the Quran-quotation spans in the ground truth. score_ocr.py also checks what a schema cannot: span bounds against the ground-truth length, ayah ranges against the Hafs verse counts, two different checkers, and that uncleared images or ground truth do not sit inside the repository.

set_id.description: A name for this frozen set, e.g. ocr-bench-v1.

frozen_on.description: Date the set was frozen (no edits after the first engine run).

image_path.description: Relative to the pages folder given to the engine runner (outside the repository unless rights.may_commit_image is true).

image_sha256.description: Checksum of the image, so a run can be tied to the exact file without committing it.

script.description: Script of the Quran quotations on the page.

diacritics.description: Diacritics level of the page text as printed.

ground_truth.description: Typed text of the page, inline (only in a manifest kept outside git, or when rights.may_commit_ground_truth is true).

ground_truth_path.description: UTF-8 text file with the ground truth, relative to --data-dir (default: the manifest's folder).

ground_truth_checked_by.description: The person who typed it and the person who checked it against the page (two different people). Names or role codes; real names need their agreement.

source.description: Where the page comes from (publication, issue, page; or who photographed it).

licence.description: The licence or written permission (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'written permission from the publisher, letter of …').

cleared_by.description: Who checked the rights (the owner, or a person the owner names).

may_commit_image.description: True only if the licence allows the image to be published in a public repository.

may_commit_ground_truth.description: True only if the licence allows the transcribed text to be published in a public repository.

may_send_to_cloud_engines.description: Whether the rights holder allows the page to be sent to a third-party OCR service. A page without true here is run only on self-hosted engines.

evidence.description: Where the written permission is kept (not the permission itself if it is private).

start.description: Character offset in the ground truth (Python string index, NFC as stored), inclusive.

printed_as_on_page.description: Always true: the ground truth reproduces the page, including a misprint, not the mushaf. A misprint is noted in notes, never corrected.
